verdict.rationale: First-party docs clearly cover the low-precision half of the story: DGX B300 is positioned for LLM inference (docs-1), lists 72 PFLOPS FP8 and 144 PFLOPS FP4 (docs-2), and claims 1.5x dense FP4 and 2x attention over B200 (docs-4), which a community spec discussion echoes (comm-1). The serving-stack half is thin: only generic NVIDIA NIM multi-node deployment and NeMo deploy docs appear (docs-16, docs-17), with nothing tying them to B300. missing for 10: B300-specific documentation of TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, or llama.cpp support, an explicit B300 serving-stack compatibility matrix, and independent hands-on inference benchmarks.
